from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.quantum_info import Statevector
import json

content.statement: Evolve Hamiltonian slowly from H₀ to H₁: H(t) = (1−t/T)H₀ + (t/T)H₁.
content.explanation: Adiabatic theorem: T ≫ max|⟨1|dH/dt|0⟩| / min Δ², where Δ is the energy gap. Adiabatic QC is equivalent to circuit‑model QC.
